name: Island Microgrid
provenance: synthetic illustrative data (P19 template) — representative week, public-catalogue-range costs; replace with project data before any decision
study_notes: The off_grid pack islands the subsea tie; the island must be adequate on its own resources.
The subsea tie is normally open (p_max_pu = 0), so the FMEA worksheet sweeps the same islanded system; set it to 1 to study tie-connected operation.
Class-C stress scenarios (dunkelflaute, heatwave) are preloaded for the FMEA sweep.

After a solve the investment case compares the plan with the island as it stands today (the existing diesels, PV, wind and battery, no grid), re-solved without the candidates. The representative week stands for each of the 15 operating years (2030-2044).
